llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must capture scroll offset with Reanimated `useAnimatedScrollHandler(...)` attached to `Animated.ScrollView onScroll`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: useAnimatedScrollHandler captures contentOffset.y into scrollY shared value and is attached to Animated.ScrollView onScroll.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must compute header visuals in `useAnimatedStyle` using `interpolate(...)` from the shared scroll value (for example height and/or opacity).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: interpolate is called directly in the render body (not inside useAnimatedStyle), so headerHeight is a plain JS number computed once at render time, not a reactive animated value driving the header style.
evidence: const headerHeight = interpolate(scrollY.value, [0, COLLAPSE_DISTANCE], [HEADER_MAX_HEIGHT, HEADER_MIN_HEIGHT], Extrapolation.CLAMP)
No useAnimatedStyle call exists anywhere in the file

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Interpolation for header collapse must use clamped extrapolation (`Extrapolation.CLAMP`) with explicit input/output ranges.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Extrapolation.CLAMP is passed as the fourth argument to interpolate with explicit input range [0, COLLAPSE_DISTANCE] and output range [HEADER_MAX_HEIGHT, HEADER_MIN_HEIGHT].
